clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Spearman rank correlations relating extreme deviation counts (|z|>2) to cognitive phenotypes (PCA-derived g-factor) from UK Biobank; additional correlation analyses with nIDPs; performance metrics (EV, MSLL) reported for model fit.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Pathogenic CNV carriers show heterogeneous, individualized deviation patterns across the brain; exemplar 1q21.1dup carriers often exhibit large negative deviations in cerebellum/brainstem/pallidum, while some 1q21.1del carriers show positive deviations in caudate/accumbens; greater negative deviations associate with poorer cognition.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Voxel-wise Jacobian normative models (age, sex, site covariates; warped BLR) explained up to ~52% of morphometric variance. Deviation metrics used z-scores and extreme threshold |z|>2 to compute per-person counts and risk profiles. In UK Biobank exemplars, 1q21.1del (n=5) had higher counts of extreme positive deviations in some regions, whereas 1q21.1dup (n=5) showed more extreme negative deviations; distributions of extreme counts were contrasted against non-CNV participants (n≈9,617 in examples). Cognitive associations: higher negative deviation burden correlated with lower cognitive performance (Spearman).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Combines multi-modal IDP normative modeling with whole-brain voxel-wise Jacobian modeling; uses likelihood warping for non-Gaussianity; provides individualized deviation maps and risk profiles; code and trained model interfaces available via PCNtoolkit and project GitHub.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Limited availability of CNV carriers with imaging (particularly younger ages); cross-sectional design; external-domain validation not shown; reliance on multi-site harmonization via covariate adjustment (no explicit ComBat).

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Models and code links: https://github.com/amarquand/PCNtoolkit and https://github.com/CharFraza/CNV_normative_modeling/. Seven-site T1 Jacobian cohort assembled from Cam-CAN, HCP, OASIS, PNC, and UK Biobank with visual QC; IDP cohort from UK Biobank (44,456 participants, 2,084 IDPs) preprocessed with FUNPACK.
